messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a short SEV scrim with CloudMerchant (SI) + Marketplace ops next Wed 9am PT. Goal: exercise shared-channel -> bridge -> handback flow and validate SLAs. @lina @ben can you join?

lina: +1 from partnerships. can we keep it to 45m? busy week.

ben: I can do 9–9:45 PT. want to test both cloud marketplace listing failure and HW-integrator auth failures.

jen: Sounds good. propose runbook: detect -> notif #marketplace-partner-ops -> oncall ack (10m) -> open bridge (SI lead) -> mitigation attempts (20m) -> handback + postmortem rake.

kumar: Add automatic fallback rule: route traffic to fallback model (quantized) after 2m of 5xx spikiness. We should test that during scrim.

alex: Good call Kumar. We'll simulate 5xx spike and token quota knock-on. Also want to validate observability: token-level tracing shows which partner triggered routing policy.

mike: I'll prep a lightweight script to generate the failure patterns. basic curl loop + header toggles. Will post in thread later:
```
#!/bin/sh
for i in $(seq 1 200); do
  curl -s -H "X-Partner: CloudMerchant" -d '{"prompt":"fail-mode"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate || true
  sleep 0.2
done
```

sara: I'll own postmortem checklist and the JIRA template. Who creates the incident ticket when we open the bridge?

ben: Marketplace oncall should create the ticket (we want centralized tracking). I'll claim ticket creation in the scrim and label it MARKET-ESCL-TEST.

deploy-bot: Bridge created: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (expires in 2 hours). Reminder: use #marketplace-partner-ops for comms.

lina: Two ops questions: 1) do we want partner oncall to be first responder or Redwood oncall? 2) what handback signal do we use? a brief regression test OK?

alex: For this scrim: partner oncall acts as first responder (they open bridge). Handback signal = successful end-to-end smoke test + < 1% 5xx over 5m. We'll record the exact checks in the runbook.

jen: I'll draft the runbook today and post a link. include fallback policy snippets and explicit roles: partner-lead, redwood-lead, SRE-observer, postmortem-owner.

kumar: Also include a short checklist for key KMS/key rotation: confirm partner keys are available in staging so auth failures are synthetic.

alex: Team next steps:
- Jen: runbook draft (posted by EOD today)
- Mike: failure script + steps (posted by EOD)
- Ben: ticket creation owner for scrim
- Sara: JIRA template + postmortem owner
- Lina: confirm partner attendees (email CloudMerchant and HW integrator)

lina: will do outreach now. tagging partner PMs: @cloudmerchant-pm, @hw-integrator-pm in the invite.

ben: one more ask: can we test shared-channel whispering? i.e., private lane for escalations between leads so we can avoid noisy public channels.

alex: yes — we'll create #marketplace-partner-ops-private for the scrim and test invite flow. good catch.

jen: putting a small SLA table into the runbook:
- first ack: 10m
- bridge established: 15m
- mitigation attempts: 20m
- handback: within 45m total

sara: all good from CS side. will capture customer-facing comm templates too.

mike: posted the failure script in GDrive: https://drive.redwood.ai/scrims/cloudmerchant-failure-script. share access granted to the list.

alex: awesome. if no objections I'll lock the scrim for next Wed 9am PT and send calendar invites with bridge link and runbook.

lina: +1. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
